newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 24.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 24.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Tuesday:
* Philippine president Fidel Ramos is recuperating after undergoing a surgery removing a cholesterol block in his right carotid artery.
* On Monday, the Dow Jones rose 4.62 points to 6,489.02. PLDT's ADR fell $2 5/8 to $51 5/8.
* On Monday, the peso was firmer at 26.30 to the U.S. dollar from 26.301.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,139.92, down 40.28.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average rate rose to 11.125 pct from 10.8125 pct.
* Finance Secretary Roberto de Ocmapo issues an order calling of the phaseout of the 90-day foreign exchange cover on oil imports staritng January next year.

* BusinessWorld reports that the two chambers of the legislature want to approve the proposed 1997 budget in principle before the end of the year, but formal action will have to wait until they resume sessions on January 21.
* The Philippine unemployment rate in October dropped to 7.4 percent compared with 8.4 percent in the same month last year, the National Satistics Office says.
* Fil-Estate group has formalised its takeover of San Jose Oil Co from the Alfredo Ramos group.
